orchestration.refreshRule: State is updated after every dispatched task and before every phase gate.
orchestration.handoffRule: No task is dispatched without a task-context handoff naming inputs, outputs, dependencies and model policy.

purpose: Deliver Yomira v6.0.0-Beta as a trustworthy manga/comic reader whose source matching, content classification, adaptation discovery and private-realm isolation are demonstrably safe, fast and offline-tolerant.
vision: One library, one OLED Plum design language, and one hard privacy boundary: public discovery stays public, private content stays private, and every source or adaptation is matched in the user's chosen language first.

objectives.name: 10x Smart Matcher
objectives.statement: Make language-aware source matching at least 10x more efficient than the frozen v5.4.1-beta baseline while preserving or improving top-1 match accuracy.
successMeasures: Primary metric is fixed in SM-001 against a recorded v5.4.1-beta baseline; no baseline is invented.
10x improvement in the agreed primary metric (median match latency or candidate evaluations).
Top-1 accuracy and MissingExtension/NoMatch outcomes are non-inferior to baseline.
All existing SmartSourceMatcher tests remain green.

objectives.name: Vault cleanup and classifier hardening
objectives.statement: Remove duplicate or misclassified Vault records and make SAFE/MATURE/EXPLICIT classification deterministic and adversarially tested.
successMeasures: Zero EXPLICIT records in the public feed or public paging sources.
Locked Vault exposes zero records, including through search and genre chips.
Adversarial corpus passes 100%, including compound tags and the MILF-party false-positive trap.
Vault duplicate count is zero after migration and re-running migration is idempotent.

objectives.name: Watchable adaptations (Anime / Hentai / Kdrama)
objectives.statement: Surface anime, adult and Kdrama adaptations as first-class watchable links without mixing adult adaptations into the public catalog.
successMeasures: Anime and Kdrama adaptations are discoverable from series detail and their own shelves.
Hentai adaptations are reachable only through the private realm.
AniList traffic respects the configured rate budget and survives 429/5xx with backoff and cache.
Last-known-good adaptation data renders offline with an explicit degraded-mode notice.

objectives.name: Vault 2.0 dual realm
objectives.statement: Replace the single Vault feature boundary with two hard-separated realms: public and private, each with its own storage, catalog, session and navigation rules.
successMeasures: Private data is never hydrated by a public query, pager or cache.
Locked private realm exposes no titles, counts, covers or suggestions.
Existing Vault content migrates losslessly and idempotently.
Panic, background lock, FLAG_SECURE and system credential verification pass security review.

objectives.name: 10-minute mobile test and release
objectives.statement: Prove v6.0.0-Beta on a physical Android device with a continuous 10-minute foreground session and an offline drill before release.
successMeasures: Signed APK installs over the existing installation without signature errors.
Ten continuous minutes of foreground use produce no crash and no ANR.
Cold start, navigation, reader entry and Vault lock/unlock complete within the session.
Offline mode degrades gracefully and recovers when connectivity returns.

inScope: SmartSourceMatcher ranking, scoring, extension resolution and settings/onboarding wiring.
ContentRatingClassifier rules, adversarial fixtures, Vault deduplication and migration.
Watchable adaptation domain model, AniList adapter, Kdrama adapter and offline cache.
Vault 2.0 public/private realm split, storage isolation, auth hardening and migration.
Signed v6.0.0-Beta build, 10-minute device test, offline drill and release evidence.
Orchestration state, model registry, risk, credit, context and performance ledgers.
outOfScope: Redesigning the OLED Plum visual language or shipping a new brand identity.
Adding new content-hosting or piracy capabilities; Yomira does not host or distribute content.
Automatic or silent APK installation from third-party sources.
Guaranteeing provider model availability beyond the dated inventory snapshot.
Fabricating benchmark scores, prices, quotas or live API verification results.

deliverables.name: v6.0.0-Beta signed APK
deliverables.acceptance: Universal and ABI APKs signed with the persistent Yomira Release key plus SHA256SUMS.txt.

deliverables.name: 10-minute mobile validation report
deliverables.acceptance: Device, build hash, session timeline, crash/ANR evidence and offline drill result recorded.

deliverables.name: Matcher 10x evidence pack
deliverables.acceptance: Frozen baseline, measurement method, before/after results and regression report.

deliverables.name: Classifier and Vault acceptance pack
deliverables.acceptance: Corpus results, dedupe report, public-feed purge proof and isolation tests.

deliverables.name: Dual-realm security review
deliverables.acceptance: Threat model, query/isolation tests, panic and screenshot-protection evidence.

constraints.statement: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash is excluded from orchestrator and subagent selection by explicit user policy. Aliases matching gemini-3.8-flash are denied before dispatch.
TASK_001 may create or modify files only under .orchestrator/.
Android 8.0+ (API 26), target/compile SDK 35, JDK 17 and the existing Gradle wrapper.
AniList and Kdrama metadata calls must respect provider rate limits, use caching and never block the UI.
Private-realm state is never written to saved instance state, public caches or analytics.
Benchmarks, prices, quotas and live availability are recorded as unknown until measured; they are never estimated as facts.

assumptions: The 2026-10-20 desktop inventory remains the dated model baseline; live availability is not implied.
The persistent Yomira Release signing key remains available and unchanged.
A physical Xiaomi M2007J3SY (Mi 10T, Android 12 / API 31) is available for the 10-minute test once USB installation is approved.
AniList remains the primary anime adaptation metadata source, with a pluggable adapter boundary.
The user approves phase gates and any expansion of scope.

phaseGates: A phase closes only when every task is completed and its acceptance evidence is linked.
Critical-path tasks cannot be reordered without updating task-dependencies.json and critical-path.json.
Model-policy violations are release blockers, not warnings.
governance.changeControl: Scope, schedule, model assignment and risk changes are recorded in .orchestrator with task ID, timestamp and rationale.
governance.evidenceStandard: Claims require a command, test run, device observation or source reference. Unmeasured values stay null.

stakeholders.name: Orchestrator
stakeholders.role: State integrity and model policy enforcement

stakeholders.name: Subagent pool
stakeholders.interest: Clear task context and eligible model assignment

stakeholders.name: Yomira users
stakeholders.interest: Fast matching, accurate content labels and private Vault

budget.creditPolicy: Track per-task credits in performance/credits.json; unknown provider quotas remain null.
guardrails: No paid overflow without owner approval.
Prefer eligible flat-rate or free endpoints where quality is sufficient.
Escalate on repeated provider failure rather than silently switching to a prohibited model.

communication.cadence: Per-task handoff, per-phase gate report, release summary.

amendmentV811.decision: Production extension runtime: consent-based IN-PROCESS DexClassLoader execution with install-time manifest+certificate verification (option A chosen by product owner over isolated-service B and scope-cut C). IsolatedProcess language retired; docs must not claim OS-level sandbox.
amendmentV811.consequence: Extension reading becomes real in v8.1.1; security wording updated honestly; full QA rounds re-run after runtime lands
